Travelers are still experiencing flight delays and cancellations as airlines work to get
back to normal after the FAA ordered an hours-long ground stop Friday.
NPR's Shonda Lee-Stuster reports.
More than 2,000 flights have been canceled and more than 7,000 flights within, into or
out of the U.S. are still delayed as of Sunday evening, according to FlightAware.com.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says things should be back to normal on Monday.
He also told ABC News they are investigating the maintenance on a router that led to the

"We don't think that someone tried to sabotage the network on the install at all, but we

Duffy has also requested more funding from Congress to help upgrade air traffic systems.
Shonda Lee-Stuster, NPR News.
A federal judge has temporarily blocked President Trump's plans to redevelop a public park and
golf course along the Potomac River in Washington, D.C., and Piers Kate Bartlett reports.
The judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work on the site, which had been
due to close on Sunday for 15 months while it was redeveloped.
Trump and avid golfer once to turn the historic site, East Potomac Golf Links, into a championship-level
golf course.
The plaintiffs in the case, including the D.C. Preservation League, argue the new course

On Saturday, before the order, Trump said on social media that anyone in the D.C. area
would be given a 50% discount.
Kate Bartlett, NPR News.
You're listening to NPR News from Washington.
The most distant, human-made object ever built is set to hit a new milestone this week.
As NPR's Ava Pukach reports, NASA's Voyager 1 will reach one light-day distance from Earth.
"A light day is the distance light travels in 24 hours.
It's equal to more than 16 billion miles from Earth.
Just launching almost 50 years ago, Voyager 1 has conducted flybys of Jupiter and Saturn
and is now charting interstellar space.
Earlier this year, NASA turned off one of its remaining science instruments to save
power and give its mission another year a breathing room.
The probe has two remaining instruments running, continuing to send data back to Earth.
To celebrate the light-day milestone, NASA is asking people to use flashlights to send
Voyager's call sign, VGR, in Morse code into the night sky shortly after sunset on
Tuesday.
Ava Pukach, NPR News.
A Georgia O'Keefe painting found buried behind coats and boxes in the closet of an apartment

The painting was found in the home of a woman in her 90s who recently died.
Christie's estimates the painting, depicting a classic New Mexico landscape with rolling
hills and earth tones, will go for between three to five million dollars.
The auction house says this painting is from 1930 and was probably the first in a series
of three.
The second one is in the New York Metropolitan Museum of Art, and the other one was four

I'm Janine Herbst, NPR News, in Washington.
